definitions.explanation: A systematic set of ideas explaining phenomena, based on reasoning and evidence.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{理論|りろん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}された→証明する：17851_shoumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: That theory was proven by experiment.

examples.japanese: {理論|りろん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理論|りろん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think his theory is correct.

notes:
{理論|りろん} is a compound: ⟦{理|り}→理：noentry⟧ (reason/principle) + ⟦{論|ろん}→論：noentry⟧ (argument/discourse).

TYPES:
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{理論|りろん} (economic theory)
- ⟦{相対性|そうたいせい}→相対性：26142_soutaisei⟧{理論|りろん} (theory of relativity)
- ⟦{進化|しんか}→進化：06029_shinka⟧{理論|りろん} (evolutionary theory)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理論|りろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to formulate a theory)
- {理論|りろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧ (to be based on theory)
- ⟦{理論的|りろんてき}→理論的：05693_rironteki⟧（な） (theoretical)
- {理論|りろん}⟦{武装|ぶそう}→武装：13235_busou⟧ (theoretical preparation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {理論|りろん} (theory - systematic explanation)
- ⟦{仮説|かせつ}→仮説：04786_kasetsu⟧ (hypothesis - proposed explanation to be tested)
- ⟦{法則|ほうそく}→法則：05143_housoku⟧ (law - established principle)
